title: D-DOIT: Training-free Adaptation of Discrete Diffusion via Doob's h-Transform
abstract: arXiv:2610.04938v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We propose D-DOIT (Discrete Doob-Oriented Inference-time Transformation), a training-free and efficient adaptation method for discrete diffusion models with generic rewards. D-DOIT formulates adaptation as sampling from a reward-tilted target distribution and realizes this transport through Doob's h-transform of the discrete diffusion reverse kernel, using only reward values rather than reward gradients. Unlike continuous diffusion, masked discrete diffusion samples categorical token-reveal transitions rather than continuous state updates. D-DOIT derives the corresponding discrete Doob's h-transform, which guides sampling by reweighting reverse transition probabilities instead of adding a drift correction. To make this transformation practical, D-DOIT avoids expensive future rollouts. translated_title: D-DOIT：基于Doob h-变换的离散扩散免训练适配方法
translated_abstract: 我们提出了D-DOIT（离散Doob导向的推理时变换），这是一种针对具有通用奖励的离散扩散模型的免训练且高效的适配方法。D-DOIT将适配问题表述为从一个奖励倾斜的目标分布中采样，并通过离散扩散反向核的Doob h-变换来实现这一传输过程，且仅使用奖励值而无需奖励梯度。与连续扩散不同，掩码离散扩散采样的是类别型的词元揭示转移，而非连续的状态更新。D-DOIT推导出了相应的离散Doob h-变换，该变换通过重新加权反向转移概率（而非添加漂移修正项）来引导采样过程。为了使这一变换切实可行，D-DOIT避免了昂贵的前向展开操作。在每个引导步骤中，D-DOIT采样候选的下一状态，利用模型预测头将每个候选补全为干净的序列，并对其进行评估……
tldr: D-DOIT提出了一种免训练的离散扩散模型适配方法，通过推导离散Doob h-变换、仅利用奖励值（无需奖励梯度和昂贵的未来展开）重新加权反向转移概率，从而在推理时高效地从奖励倾斜的目标分布中采样。
